title: Advanced Separation: Distillation, Chromatography & More
summary: The tools real labs use: distillation, fractional distillation, chromatography, crystallisation, centrifugation, separating funnels and sublimation.

ib.note: Chromatography and Rf values extend into MYP 4–5 analysis

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 5: Exploring Mixtures and their Separation (crystallisation, distillation, chromatography, sublimation, centrifugation)
Curiosity Ch 9: The Amazing World of Solutes, Solvents and Solutions (saturated solutions)

objectives: I can explain how simple distillation separates a solvent from a solution, and name the parts of the apparatus.
I can describe fractional distillation for liquids with different boiling points.
I can use paper chromatography to separate dyes and calculate an Rf value.
I can choose between evaporation, crystallisation, centrifugation, a separating funnel and sublimation for a given mixture.
misconceptions: Black ink is a single substance.
Crystallisation and evaporation are the same thing.
